subject: Reading
description: The Reading LDG maps the developmental progression from sound awareness to fluent comprehension. Teachers trace difficulties backward to find the earliest missing prerequisite.

competencies.label: Phonemic Awareness
competencies.description: Hearing, identifying, and manipulating individual sounds (phonemes) in spoken words.

misconceptions.observed: Cannot tell you the first sound in 'dog'.
misconceptions.evidence: Says 'dog' when asked for the first sound; cannot isolate /d/.
misconceptions.strategy: Oral sound games; 'I spy' with sounds; clap syllables then segment.

competencies.label: Phonics (Letter-Sound Mapping)
competencies.description: Connecting letters (graphemes) to sounds (phonemes); decoding written words by sounding them out.

misconceptions.observed: Guesses words from first letter. Cannot sound out unfamiliar words.
misconceptions.rootGap: Words memorized visually; letters not mapped to sounds.
misconceptions.evidence: Reads 'house' correctly but reads 'horse' as 'house' — relies on shape, not decoding.
misconceptions.strategy: Systematic phonics: teach letter-sound correspondences explicitly. Use decodable texts that match known sounds.

misconceptions.observed: Knows all letter sounds but cannot blend them into a word.
misconceptions.strategy: Continuous blending: stretch sounds without pausing. Start with two-sound words.

competencies.label: Fluency
competencies.description: Reading with speed, accuracy, and proper expression; automatic word recognition frees cognitive resources for comprehension.

misconceptions.observed: Reads word-by-word, pausing between each. Cannot follow the sentence meaning.
misconceptions.rootGap: Decoding is not yet automatic; all cognitive effort goes to word recognition.
misconceptions.evidence: Reads accurately but very slowly; cannot answer 'what was that sentence about?'
misconceptions.strategy: Repeated reading of familiar texts; paired reading; model fluent reading with expression.

misconceptions.observed: Reads fast but with no expression; monotone even for questions and dialogue.
misconceptions.rootGap: Does not connect punctuation and sentence structure to meaning.
misconceptions.evidence: Reads a question mark the same as a period; ignores commas.
misconceptions.strategy: Readers' theatre; mark up text with expression cues; record and listen back.

competencies.label: Vocabulary
competencies.description: Knowing the meaning of words encountered in text; word knowledge is the bridge from decoding to comprehension.

misconceptions.observed: Decodes a word correctly but cannot use it in a sentence.
misconceptions.rootGap: Word recognition without meaning; vocabulary has not kept pace with decoding.
misconceptions.evidence: Reads 'enormous' fluently but shrugs when asked what it means.
misconceptions.strategy: Pre-teach key vocabulary before reading; word maps; use words in multiple contexts.

competencies.label: Reading Comprehension
competencies.description: Understanding, interpreting, and reflecting on written text; the ultimate goal of reading.

misconceptions.observed: Reads a paragraph perfectly but cannot tell you what happened.
misconceptions.rootGap: Decoding is automatic but the child is not monitoring for meaning.
misconceptions.evidence: Answers 'I don't know' or makes up unrelated answers to comprehension questions.
misconceptions.strategy: Stop-and-think strategy after each sentence; visualisation; retelling in own words.

misconceptions.observed: Can answer literal questions but cannot infer.
misconceptions.rootGap: Has not learned to combine text evidence with background knowledge.
misconceptions.evidence: When asked 'How is the character feeling?' quotes text but cannot interpret.
misconceptions.strategy: Think-aloud modelling; inference grids (clue + what I know = inference).
